meta.audience: App developers using SQLite locally who are evaluating a local-first sync engine (individual devs and small teams)
scenarios: developer evaluates sync options on the landing page
open-source user arrives from GitHub and checks pricing/support

style.direction: Quiet engineering register: low-saturation ink neutrals with a single cobalt accent, Inter typography, asymmetric two-column sections, real code/terminal visuals, evidence over decoration
do_not: pill badge above the hero title
avatar dot arrays and five-star ratings

rules: exactly one primary action per page (quickstart); it may repeat only in top nav and hero
visible focus ring on all interactive elements
quiet outline actions only, so the page primary CTA stays unique
recommended tier highlighted via surface + border weight, never via color blocks or gradients

invariants.description: 顶部导航必须保留：品牌标识 + Docs / How it works / Pricing / GitHub 链接 + 主 CTA 按钮，键盘可访问；任何 refine/redesign 不得移除或降级。
hero 主 CTA（指向 5 分钟快速上手文档的 Get started）必须保留，且保持全页唯一主操作；旁边至多一个次级动作（GitHub 源码链接）。

project: single static page: index.html + tokens.css + styles.css, zero build step
no font files downloaded; Inter resolved from the local stack with system-ui fallback
all colors referenced via tokens.css custom properties; no hex literals in HTML or styles.css

pages.index.html: section rhythm fixed at 96px vertical padding (within the 80-128 range); pricing table sits below the fold; hero is left-aligned asymmetric; trust strip contains only verifiable elements (MIT license, public repo, no cloud account required) — no avatar arrays, no star ratings
